arbor.line: A monument to build beneath the arbors
stanza: A monument to build beneath the arbors
Upon a plinth that towers towards the trees
Let every vessel pitching hard to starboard
Lay its head on summer's freckled knees

harbor.line: Sailin' heart ships through broken harbors
stanza: Sailin' heart ships through broken harbors
Out on the waves in the night
Still the searcher must ride the dark horse
Racing alone in his fright

harbor.line: Come and take the pleasures of the harbor
stanza: Oh, soon your sailing will be over
Come and take the pleasures of the harbor

harbor.line: As the day he sailed through the Harbor
stanza: He would rock and stare out the window
But his eyes are still just as clear
As the day he sailed through the Harbor
And come ashore on that island of tears
My grandfather's days were numbered
But I won't let his memory die
'Cause he gave me the gift of this country
And the look in his immigrant eyes

harbor.line: I heard them in the harbor
stanza: I heard Woodrow Wilson's guns
I heard them in the harbor
Saying Veracruz was dying

harbour.line: On our lady of the harbour
harbour.linePrev: And the sun pours down like honey
harbour.lineNext: And she shows you where to look
